ValidationRule.errorConditionFormula: AND(NOT($Permission.Skip_Validations_Permission), NOT(ISBLANK(RecordTypeId)), ISCHANGED(RecordTypeId), OR( ISPICKVAL(Status__c,'Approved'), ISPICKVAL(Status__c,'Voided'), ISPICKVAL(Status__c,'Pending')))
ValidationRule.errorMessage: Record Type can`t be change if Status is Approved, Voided or Pending
